topic: A sinking fund for one bill you know is coming

artifacts.angle: three steps: pick one yearly or irregular bill (car registration, a renewal, gifts), divide it by the months until it is due, move that amount on payday into its own pot; the viewer does the division, no figure claimed
artifacts.hook: Your car registration isn't a surprise. It just arrives like one.
artifacts.title: Stop Getting Blindsided By Bills You Knew Were Coming
